config.description: Bot watchdog configuration. Every member is optional; an absent member takes its default. Negative values, non-integer values and unknown members are rejected by the contract reader (see watchdog.md §2). Zero is valid and disables the corresponding active threshold/limit, except the two goal totals where zero means no goal-wide budget is configured.

heartbeatTimeoutMs.description: Heartbeat silence threshold in milliseconds. 0 disables heartbeat flags.

turnDeadlineMs.description: Default turn deadline in milliseconds. 0 gives a turn no deadline.

taskDeadlineMs.description: Default task deadline in milliseconds. 0 gives a task no deadline.

routineDeadlineMs.description: Default routine deadline in milliseconds. 0 gives a routine no deadline.

repeatedToolCalls.description: Same tool name+argumentsDigest count that raises repeated_tool_signature. The comparison is >=; 0 disables the check.

repeatedToolErrors.description: Same tool+error count that raises repeated_tool_error. The comparison is >=; 0 disables the check.

maxUnitTokens.description: Per-unit token quota. The comparison is strict >; 0 disables the token quota.

maxUnitCostUsd.description: Per-unit cost quota in USD. The comparison is strict >; 0 disables the cost quota.

goalMaxTotalTokens.description: Goal-wide aggregate token budget. 0 means not configured; per-unit quota remains the enforced P0 check.

goalMaxTotalCostUsd.description: Goal-wide aggregate cost budget. 0 means not configured; per-unit quota remains the enforced P0 check.

tickMs.description: Caller evaluation cadence in milliseconds. The monitor itself does not sleep; the host calls tick() on this cadence and after observed events.

historyLimit.description: Maximum recent in-memory flags retained. Runtime stores at most max(1, value); flags(limit:) clamps to the configured value (so 0 returns no history).

maxUnits.description: Maximum tracked units before the oldest unit is evicted. Runtime uses max(1, value).

flagData.description: data of one durable watchdog.flagged event (see watchdog.md §5).
